name: general_law_v1
description: Routing, source-policy and legal-period checks for GENERAL legal questions. It contains NO gold answer texts: verifying what the law actually says needs a human legal reviewer reading the official text. What it fixes in advance is (a) which pipeline a question must be routed to, (b) which source classes are acceptable, and (c) which legal period the question implies.

reference_portals.note: Landing pages only. Deep links to specific Acts must be confirmed by a person; none are asserted here.
